artifacts.summary: 9-phase mechanical retarget of skill-orchestrate Stage/Stage-MT citations to Move 1-4 vocabulary across 18 source-store files, with a per-hit classification ledger gate and a scoped acceptance grep.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's agent-system documentation tree, the word 'Stage N' belongs to five independent, lexically colliding numbering vocabularies: (1) skill-orchestrate's own engine stages (now replaced by Move 1-4), (2) the generic agent-execution-flow convention in context/templates/agent-template.md and every agents/*.md derived from it, (3) the generic skill-body preflight/postflight flow (context/patterns/skill-preflight-flow.md et al.), (4) /meta's interview stages, and (5) individual scripts' retained internal labels (e.g. orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh's live 'Stage 3.5 (Dispatch Prep)', orchestrate-stage5-gates.sh). A naive grep for 'Stage MT-|Stage [0-8]' over core/{context,docs,skills,commands,agents} matches ~77 files but only ~18 cite skill-orchestrate. Any sweep that renames section anchors in this tree must classify every hit against these five vocabularies line-by-line; a whole-file find-replace corrupts four live, correct conventions. The reliable discriminator for vocabulary (1) is co-occurrence with the literal strings 'skill-orchestrate', 'orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh', 'orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh', or 'orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh'.
